title: Separating
tagline: Your own money, a fair split and the house sorted, calmly and step by step.
trigger: A second rent next to the shared home, a lawyer or mediator for a divorce, or a partner's income that stops arriving.

steps.title: An account of your own
steps.description: Your own account and card, so your income lands where only you can reach it.
steps.why: Nothing changes on the joint account until both of you agree.
steps.result: Your own account is open; your salary can be redirected with one tap.

steps.title: Split the joint account
steps.description: An overview of shared direct debits and savings, and a proposal to split them. Both of you approve.
steps.why: KBC never closes or empties a joint account on one person's request.
steps.result: Split proposal ready for both of you to approve.

steps.title: A family mediator
steps.description: An accredited family mediator helps you agree on money, the home and the children, usually faster and cheaper than court.
steps.why: The mediator only receives your name, e-mail and family situation. KBC earns nothing from it.
steps.result: Intake booked with an accredited family mediator.

steps.title: Keep the house or sell it
steps.description: Can one of you take over the mortgage? An indicative value of the house and the numbers for both options.
steps.why: Based on your existing loan and income; nothing is shared.

win.customer: A clear choice about the home

steps.result: Both options worked out: taking over the loan, or selling (illustrative).

steps.title: Update beneficiaries
steps.description: Check who receives your life insurance and pension savings, and change it if you want.
steps.why: An ex-partner often stays the beneficiary by mistake.

win.customer: Your money goes where you want

steps.result: Beneficiaries checked; changes ready for your signature.

steps.title: Keep the documents
steps.description: Agreements, statements and the split proposal in your digital vault.
steps.why: You will need them for the court, the notary and your tax return.
steps.result: Documents filed in your digital vault.
